newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: SOCCER-KLUIVERT GOAL EARNS AJAX POINT AT FEYENOORD.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-KLUIVERT GOAL EARNS AJAX POINT AT FEYENOORD.

text.p: Feyenoord and Ajax Amsterdam drew 2-2 in Sunday's Dutch first division clash which saw three penalties awarded in the opening 15 minutes.

Patrick Kluivert blasted over in the second minute after Nigerian winger Tijjani Babagida was pulled back in the area. Two minutes later Ronald Koeman fared better at the other end, converting his spot-kick after Henryk Larsson was brought down by Winston Bogarde.
In the 15th minute Ajax drew level, Ronald de Boer scoring from the penalty spot after Geoffrey Claes had handled.
But within a minute Feyenoord regained the lead, Bernard Schuiteman heading home the rebound after Koeman's free kick had come crashing back off the bar.
Midway through the second half Ajax rescued a point when Kluivert slotted home after a neat one-two with Nordin Wooter.
